app.title: Wanderly
app.tagline: Enter your origin, destination, and preferences, and this site creates a detailed travel handbook for you

facts: Tip: Photograph your ID documents before you leave and back them up to the cloud.
Tip: A one-day transit pass is often cheaper than buying single tickets in many cities.
Tip: Check local tipping customs ahead of time to avoid awkward moments.
Tip: Traveling on weekdays or off-season can noticeably cut your budget.
Tip: Bring an empty water bottle and fill it up after security.
Tip: Download offline maps in advance in case the connection is spotty.
